books.section: The Jackson Presidency and Jacksonian Democracy

stimulus.text: Paraphrase of 5 Steps to a 5 2024, Chapter 13, and Princeton Review, Chapter 8: In earlier elections, congressional caucuses chose the parties' nominees, and electors were often chosen by state legislatures. In 1800, only five states let voters choose presidential electors directly; by 1824, 18 of 24 states did so. When the Democratic-Republican caucus chose William H. Crawford in 1824, Adams, Clay, and Jackson all challenged the nomination, and attacks on the caucus as undemocratic brought the caucus system down. Jackson believed his supporters should take over federal offices held by Adams's partisans, holding that any reasonably capable citizen could do a government job. Trading jobs for political favors came to be known as the spoils system.

stem: The fall of the congressional caucus best shows that

options.text: Congress lost all of its powers over elections and nominations
options.misconception: Congress kept its lawmaking powers; it lost only its grip on nominations.

options.text: voters and candidates rejected elite control of nominations
political parties came to an end
options.misconception: Parties did not end; new ones, Democrats and Whigs, grew stronger.
Electors remained; what changed was who chose the nominees and the electors.

rationales.A: Congress kept its powers; it lost only the nomination.
rationales.B: When the caucus picked Crawford, three rivals challenged it as undemocratic, and the attacks brought the caucus down.
rationales.C: Parties grew stronger, with Democrats and Whigs organizing mass campaigns.
rationales.D: Electors stayed; the nomination process changed.
rationales.general:
1. Name the old way. A small group of congressmen in caucus picked the party's nominee.
2. Name the challenge. Adams, Clay, and Jackson all defied the caucus choice of Crawford in 1824.
3. Name the result. The attacks on the caucus as undemocratic ended it.
Background: With voters choosing electors in 18 of 24 states, a caucus choice no longer carried weight.
Remember: when the voters arrive, the back room loses its power.
